49c7f2f7996daee7e470035cd03b4836909f0955.sourceText:
| 示例 | 讲了什么 | 新出现的语法 | 为什么这样写 | 注意事项 |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 示例 1 | 旧 enum 问题 vs enum class | `enum class`、`static_cast<int>()` | 旧 enum 名字污染、隐式转 int；enum class 解决 | 需要整数值时必须显式转换 |
| 示例 2 | 指定底层类型和 switch 用法 | `enum class : uint8_t`、switch + enum class | 指定底层类型能节省内存（如嵌入式场景） | `sizeof(enum class)` 不等于成员个数 |
| 示例 3 | 在 struct 中使用 enum class | enum class 做 struct 成员、比较操作 | 表示状态、等级等有限取值集合 | enum class 支持 `==`, `<`, `>` 等比较 |
49c7f2f7996daee7e470035cd03b4836909f0955.translatedText:
| Example | What was discussed | Newly introduced syntax | Why it is written this way | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| Example 1 | Old enum problem vs enum class | `enum class`、`static_cast<int>()` | Old enum name pollution, implicit conversion to int; enum class solves this | Must explicitly convert when an integer value is needed |
| Example 2 | Specifying the underlying type and switch usage | `enum class : uint8_t`、switch \+ enum class | Specifying the underlying type can save memory (e\.g\., embedded scenarios) | `sizeof(enum class)` is not equal to the number of members |
| Example 3 | Using enum class in a struct | enum class as a struct member, comparison operations | Represents finite value sets such as states and levels | enum class supports `==`, `<`, `>` and other comparisons |
